reviews.text: I am absolutely in love with the texture of the TOCOBO Cleansing Oil. It makes taking off full makeup completely effortless at the end of the day. Despite containing nourishing ingredients like olive oil and coconut oil, it feels incredibly light on the skin. Best of all, it doesn't clog my pores or leave behind any heavy, greasy residue. It has quickly become a holy grail step in my skincare routine!
reviews.zh: 我真係好愛 TOCOBO Cleansing Oil 嘅質地。一日完結時卸晒全妝都好輕鬆。雖然含有橄欖油同椰子油等滋養成分，但搽喺皮膚上感覺非常輕盈。最好嘅係，佢唔會堵塞毛孔，亦唔會留低厚重、油膩嘅殘留。佢好快成為我護膚流程中嘅心頭好步驟！

reviews.text: I've been using the **TOCOBO Cleansing Oil**, and I'm really pleased with it. It effortlessly removes makeup, sunscreen, and daily impurities without stripping my skin. The lightweight texture emulsifies well with water and rinses off cleanly, leaving my skin feeling soft, fresh, and hydrated. It doesn't leave a greasy residue and works well even on sensitive skin. Overall, it's an excellent cleansing oil that makes the first step of my skincare routine easy and effective.
reviews.zh: 我一直用緊 **TOCOBO Cleansing Oil**，我好滿意。佢可以輕鬆卸除化妝、防曬同日常污垢，而唔會令皮膚脫脂。質地輕盈，同水混合得好好，好容易沖洗乾淨，令皮膚感覺柔軟、清新同水潤。唔會留低油膩殘留，即使係敏感皮膚都好好用。整體嚟講，係一款出色嘅卸妝油，令護膚流程第一步變得簡單又有效。

reviews.text:
The TOCOBO Calamine Pore Control Cleansing Oil feels really gentle and lightweight on the skin. It melts makeup and sunscreen easily and then turns milky when you add water, so it rinses off clean without leaving a heavy oily layer.

For oily skin and pores, I like that it helps remove excess sebum without stripping or making my skin feel tight. My skin felt smoother and less congested after using it, and it didn’t break me out or leave residue. It’s a nice first step cleanser if you’re dealing with blackheads or clogged pores, especially in the T-zone.
reviews.zh:
TOCOBO Calamine Pore Control Cleansing Oil 用喺皮膚上感覺好溫和、輕盈。佢好易溶化妝同防曬，加水之後會變成乳白色，所以好容易沖走，唔會留低厚厚嘅油膜。

對於油性皮膚同毛孔，我鍾意佢可以去除多餘皮脂，而唔會令皮膚脫脂或者繃緊。用完之後，我嘅皮膚感覺更平滑，毛孔冇咁阻塞，亦冇爆痘或者殘留。如果你有黑頭或者毛孔阻塞問題，尤其係 T 字位，呢款係一款好好嘅第一步潔面產品。

reviews.text: I’ve tried many cleansing oils, but I’m not a fan of oily feeling on my skin, that’s why this one strongly stood up for me. It is rather milky and doesn’t give me unpleasant sensations. It is also a great fighter against black dotes on my nose, I could see a difference after only few days of use. It brightens the skin and leaves smooth feeling after use. I used 2 bottles already and will be ordering again as I can really see it works for me.
reviews.zh: 我試過好多款卸妝油，但我唔鍾意皮膚有油膩感，所以呢款真係令我好突出。佢比較似乳白色，唔會令我感覺唔舒服。佢對付鼻頭嘅黑頭都好有效，用咗幾日就見到改善。用完之後皮膚亮咗，感覺光滑。我已經用咗兩樽，而家會再訂，因為我真係見到佢對我有效。

reviews.text:
I’m really impressed with this cleansing oil. I’ve been using it for a while, even though I don’t usually use oil cleansers because I have oily skinbut this one actually works really well for my skin type.
It’s not harsh at all, and the scent is moderate, not too strong, so it doesn’t feel overwhelming. When you massage it into your skin, you can feel it breaking down impurities and clogged pores, almost like you can feel the texture under your fingers.
After rinsing, it leaves my skin feeling soft and thoroughly cleansed. It removes everythingnot just makeup, but also skincare residue, excess oils, and more. I really like this product, and I’m thinking of repurchasing it again.
reviews.zh:
我真係好欣賞呢款卸妝油。我用咗一段時間，雖然我平時唔會用卸妝油，因為我係油性皮膚，但係呢款真係好啱我嘅膚質。
佢一啲都唔刺激，香味適中，唔會太濃，所以唔會令人覺得難受。當你將佢按摩入皮膚，可以感覺到佢分解污垢同堵塞毛孔，好似可以用手指感覺到質地咁。
沖洗之後，皮膚感覺柔軟，清潔得好徹底。佢唔止可以卸走化妝，仲可以卸走護膚殘留、多餘油脂等等。我真係好鍾意呢款產品，我考慮再買。

reviews.text:
I’ve been using this Cleansing Oil, and it’s a really effective first cleanse. 
The oil has a light texture that spreads easily and melts makeup, sunscreen, and impurities without feeling heavy.

What I like most is that it leaves my skin clean but balanced, never greasy or stripped. 
The calamine helps calm the skin and makes my pores look clearer with regular use. 
It rinses off well and works perfectly as the first step of a double cleansing routine.
reviews.zh:
我一直用緊呢款卸妝油，係一個非常有效嘅第一步潔面。
油嘅質地輕，容易推開，可以溶解化妝、防曬同污垢，唔會覺得沉重。

我最鍾意嘅係，佢令皮膚保持清潔同平衡，從來唔會油膩或者脫脂。
持續使用嘅話，爐甘石（calamine）有助舒緩皮膚，令毛孔睇落更清晰。
佢容易沖洗，好適合做雙重潔面嘅第一步。

reviews.text:
It's one of the most refreshing oil cleansers with its rosy scent and milky translucent texture.
It effectively melts impurities and my most rebellious mascara haha it instantly removes it.
I'm currently using about once to twice a week, usually to have a clean face and pores before a warm bath.
The texture of the oil cleanser feels heavy at first but once it emulsified with water it turns to a rosy scented milk that make feel like you're Cleopatra with her rose petals and milk bath.
After rinsing my face with water then regular cleanser, my skin feels hydrated, balanced and clean ✨️✨️
reviews.zh:
佢係最清新嘅卸妝油之一，有玫瑰香味，質地係乳白半透明。
佢可以有效溶解污垢，連我最頑固嘅睫毛膏都即刻卸走，哈哈。
我而家大約每星期用一至兩次，通常係喺洗熱水澡之前，令面同毛孔乾淨。
卸妝油起初質地好重，但係同水乳化之後，就會變成玫瑰香嘅牛奶，令人覺得自己好似埃及豔后，用玫瑰花瓣同牛奶浴咁。
用水沖走臉之後，再用普通潔面產品，皮膚感覺水潤、平衡又乾淨 ✨️✨️

reviews.text: This oil to milk makeup remover is on e of the best i ever tried. like it says in the descriprion is an oil meets milk consistency. I found that i prefer it to oils, it remuves any kind of makeup like the best of oils but it doesnt blur my vision like some olis do ( I don't know about others byt i vlhave this problem with oils). It is very easy to remuve. it leaves my face hydrated and soft after use. will definitely by again.
reviews.zh: 呢款油轉奶狀卸妝產品係我試過最好嘅之一。正如描述所講，佢質地係油同奶嘅混合。我覺得我比較鍾意呢款多過普通卸妝油，佢可以卸走任何化妝，效果同最好嘅卸妝油一樣，但唔似有啲卸妝油咁令我眼前模糊（我唔知其他人點，但我用油會有呢個問題）。好容易卸。用完令面水潤、柔軟。一定會再買。
